load_annotations_CocoDataset: load COCO style annotations from a JSON file into the CocoDataset using the pycocotools COCO API
get_ann_info_CocoDataset: get bounding box and mask annotation info for a specific image index in the COCO dataset
evaluate_CocoDataset: evaluate detection or segmentation results using COCO protocol metrics like mAP, AR, and classwise AP
results2json_CocoDataset: convert detection or segmentation results to COCO style JSON files for bbox, segm, or proposal output
filter_imgs_CocoDataset: filter out images that are too small or have no ground truth annotations in the COCO dataset
